description: INLINED COPY of the DVWDesign canonical preset (RootDispatcher//config/renovate-base.json). DocuMind is a PUBLIC repo and RootDispatcher is PRIVATE, so Renovate cannot resolve the shared preset here — it halted with "Cannot find preset's package" (issue #16) and stopped opening every PR. Public repos therefore inline the policy. KEEP IN SYNC with config/renovate-base.json in RootDispatcher; see docs/ecosystem/DEPENDENCY-GOVERNANCE.md › Public repositories.

packageRules.description: Internal @design-dvw/* are private GitHub Packages governed by the shared-packages release + consumer-registry flow — NOT by Renovate. Disabling avoids private-registry 'no-result' lookup failures (the Renovate bot has no read:packages auth).
Group all Storybook packages so they move together in ONE PR (they must stay on the same version).

NO AUTOMERGE, ANY update type. Every dependency change lands through a reviewed PR — there is no unattended merge lane in this ecosystem (operator decision 2026-07-26). Staleness is handled by the PR-age watchdog that warns the operator, NOT by automerging. Deliberately last so it overrides any automerge inherited from config:recommended.
Major version bumps are additionally labelled so the watchdog and reviewers can triage them first.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Renovate does NOT open security PRs. Dependabot owns security updates (org-enforced); this avoids duplicate security PRs.
